data.one_liner: Converts SVG icons to OpenType fonts and generates Flutter-compatible icon classes.
data.what_it_does: Processes a directory of SVG files, converts them into a single OTF font file, and generates a Dart class with identifiers for easy use in Flutter apps (similar to Material Icons). It provides both a CLI tool and a Dart API.
use_when: You have a custom set of SVG icons that you want to bundle into a single icon font.
You want code-generated static constants for your custom icon font to ensure type safety and autocomplete.
avoid_when: You prefer rendering vector SVGs directly at runtime without converting them to a font.
Your project requires complex multi-color vector assets that cannot be represented in a single-color font format.
strengths: Works fully in Dart without external platform dependencies.
Provides both a CLI tool and programmatic API functions.
Supports YAML configuration via pubspec.yaml or icon_font.yaml.
weaknesses: Generated font uses PostScript Table version 3.0 which doesn't contain glyph names.
Limited support for certain complex SVG attributes and features.
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev dependency and run via CLI or add to pubspec.yaml.
